extension.summary: tofa media server: user interface, plus a browsable video source
extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - The Skip Intro and Skip Credits buttons no longer stay on screen for the whole of a long intro or credits. They now hide after a few seconds, as in the other tofa apps, and come back whenever you bring up the player controls while the intro or credits are still playing. - On a series, the line under the title on the Details page now gives the year and length of the episode the Play button is offering, rather than the year the series started and its average episode length. The synopsis there already described that episode. - Settings > Appearance > Media cards gains "Hide episode spoilers". Details already hid the picture of episodes past the one you are on when your account asked for it, but only the other tofa apps could switch it; now this one can too, and the change follows your account to all of them.

extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Updating the add-on no longer shows a brief error message while the new version installs. 0.9.26 closed one cause; this closes the other, in the background service. Because the version being replaced is the one running during an update, this fix takes effect from the update after this one. - The Home screen now shows the same rows as the other tofa apps: the default rows a profile is missing (Recently Released Movies and TV Shows on older profiles) appear at the end, as they do on the web and on macOS. - Discover rows on Home and in Settings > Appearance carry the server's own names -- "Trending Shows", "New Series Worth Starting" -- so a row reads the same in the "Add a row" list, in the editor and on Home. - New "Leaving soon" row (server 0.9.35): titles the server's lifecycle rules have flagged, with the date each one leaves. Add it under Settings > Appearance > Home screen. - Suggested for You reads "Popular on Your Server" while the server has too little watch history to personalise it, as in the other apps.

extension.description:
An unofficial client for the tofa media server (tofa.tv), in two parts.
Under Programs, tofa opens a full user interface: Home, Browse, Discover, Search, title detail with cast and episodes, its own player chrome, and Settings.
Under Video add-ons, the same library appears as a browsable source, so it can also be used in widgets, favourites and Kodi's own containers.
Both play through Kodi's native VideoPlayer, negotiating DirectPlay/DirectFile so Dolby Vision, TrueHD/DTS-HD passthrough and refresh-rate matching reach it untouched.
extension.disclaimer: An unofficial tofa client, engineered with the tofa team, who also help support it.
extension.news: - Your server can now see how a Kodi stream is doing. The Activity page used to say "This client doesn't report live metrics" beside a Kodi session; it now shows the player's state, how many seconds of video Kodi has buffered ahead, and whether playback has stalled -- so whoever runs the server can tell a healthy stream from a struggling one at a glance, and has real numbers to go on when something does go wrong. Kodi cannot measure dropped frames or network throughput, so those two tiles stay empty rather than showing a guess. Everything reported goes to your own media server and nowhere else, as the Privacy page says. - Stopping playback tells the server once instead of twice. The second message was always answered "already stopped"; it is no longer sent. - Built against tofa media server 0.9.35. An older server is not refused and the add-on carries on working, but it now says so once per session, the same as it always has when it meets a server older than it was built for. Nothing else changes in this release on account of it.

extension.summary: Fonts for the tofa for Kodi add-on
extension.description:
The typefaces the tofa for Kodi add-on draws its own screens in: Inter Tight, Roboto Mono and the Lucide icon set.
Installed automatically as a dependency of tofa for Kodi. It provides font files and nothing else: no screens, no settings, and nothing runs. It is not useful on its own.
Kodi looks inside enabled font resources for any font file it cannot find in the active skin, so tofa's screens can name these files without a copy of them being placed in the skin.
